newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * The Supreme Defence Council, chaired by President Emil Constantinescu, met to discuss progress towards Romania's goal of integration into NATO.
* Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea said his government had prepared a package of measures to ensure Romania's macro-economic stability.
* Talks with international lenders on resuming credits to Romania are expected to end tonight, state radio said.
* Ciorbea presented National Peasant Party leaders data on Romania's economy and announced steps to halt economic decline.
Ciorbea said the new measures, including full-scale price liberalisation, would be implemented starting next Tuesday.
